entries.name: Top Title
entries.geometry: Title Only V1; host owns safe inset.
entries.responsive_rule: Remaining width; ellipsis per source contract; may grow for scaled text.
entries.acceptance_rule: Match Title Only authority and avoid status/cutout collisions.

entries.name: Back
entries.responsive_rule: Keep target and 20sp BACK_TITLE; ellipsize at narrow widths.
entries.acceptance_rule: Return to immediate parent; use registered icon, no text-glyph substitute.

entries.name: Top Navigation Action
entries.geometry: Page-specific utility order; title uses remaining width.
entries.responsive_rule: Do not reorder actions; title may ellipsize at larger scale.
entries.acceptance_rule: Preserve frozen action order; no default glass pill or extra action.

entries.name: Primary Button
entries.geometry: 28dp radius; dimensions stable across states; Result uses explicit page exception.
entries.responsive_rule: Keep label and action reachable; width ratio belongs to consumer contract.
entries.acceptance_rule: Match semantic variant and state authority; no ad-hoc radius.

entries.name: Text Action
entries.responsive_rule: Single line; retain invisible hit area, no visible pill.
entries.acceptance_rule: Use STRONG/NORMAL/MUTED/ON_MEDIA tone and 90ms press transition.

entries.name: Icon Action
entries.responsive_rule: Keep touch target; page contract owns glyph scale.
entries.acceptance_rule: Use registered SVG; semantic selected state belongs to page.

entries.name: Glass Surface
entries.geometry: GLASS_A/B/C opacity family; page owns padding/radius/height.
entries.responsive_rule: Intrinsic content height and scroll; no stretch to fill viewport.
entries.acceptance_rule: Preserve contrast and page geometry; shared generic padding/height contract remains open.

entries.name: Card
entries.responsive_rule: Grow with content; no universal ratio/crop.
entries.acceptance_rule: Use named page card contract; cross-page shared envelope is not established.

entries.name: Hero
entries.geometry: Page Frozen outer frame; HOME/DETAIL use HERO_ADAPTIVE.
entries.responsive_rule: Trusted safe Fill or same-source Safe Fit + ambient; no stretch.
entries.acceptance_rule: Preserve original bytes, FishSafeRect and frozen frame.

entries.name: Image
entries.geometry: Consumer-owned content rect; no non-uniform scaling.
entries.responsive_rule: Evidence Fit or subject-safe crop per media role.
entries.acceptance_rule: Use exact declared media mode; preserve source and safe subject.

entries.name: Video
entries.visual: FishRecordDetail media contracts; Fish Media Display V1
entries.geometry: Container/aspect remains consumer-owned; no universal video ratio found.
entries.responsive_rule: Fit/cover and controls per page contract; respect Insets.
entries.acceptance_rule: Do not fabricate video fixtures; generic playback behavior remains open.

entries.name: Metadata Row
entries.geometry: Row height, icon alignment, truncation page-specific.
entries.responsive_rule: Wrap or ellipsize only per field contract.
entries.acceptance_rule: Every field needs source/empty behavior; generic shared geometry open.

entries.name: Statistic Card
entries.visual: Normal Home V1.1 typography / NH04 states
entries.geometry: Home statistic group geometry only; no shared card contract.
entries.responsive_rule: Preserve Home groups and page-specific Font A.
entries.acceptance_rule: Keep record data authority; no cross-page contract yet.

entries.name: Selector
entries.geometry: Species Picker PARTIAL; generic selector geometry absent.
entries.responsive_rule: Preserve result/feedback flow; accessibility states pending.
entries.acceptance_rule: Keep out of engineering freeze until C-014 scope is closed.

entries.name: Search
entries.geometry: My Catches page-only; no shared geometry.
entries.responsive_rule: IME-aware; preserve query and visible content.
entries.acceptance_rule: Promote only after shared focus, clear, empty/error behavior is defined.

entries.name: Bottom Sheet
entries.geometry: No generic snap/dismiss geometry authority found.
entries.responsive_rule: Respect bottom gesture inset and IME; internal content scrolls.
entries.acceptance_rule: Do not reuse cross-page until snap, dismissal, focus and IME behavior are approved.
